newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ police search for missing U.S. tourist.
newsitem.headline: NZ police search for missing U.S. tourist.

text.p: New Zealand police said they would launch a major search on Sunday for an American tourist missing on a peninsula on the country's South Island.

A police spokesperson said on Saturday a search from 5 p.m. until dusk by an Air Force Iroquois helicopter had not succeeded in finding the woman, lost in the Akaroa area on Banks Peninsula, southeast of the city of Christchurch.
The woman was identified as Robyn Paige Kinker, 30, from Washington state. She had been travelling the South Island for some time.
Kinker is believed to have entered an area covered mainly with tussock and scrub.
Her vehicle was seen by a farmer on Friday and he called police after seeing it in the same spot, unmoved, on Saturday afternoon, police said.
